## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor / maintenance
- [ ] Data-source or integration change

## Validation

Describe the tests, commands, or manual checks you performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept the change focused and avoided unrelated refactors.
- [ ] I added or updated tests where practical.
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-visible or interface changes.
- [ ] I did not commit credentials, API keys, private financial data, caches, or local build artifacts.
- [ ] I considered backward compatibility and failure/degraded modes.
